prompt: This is an evidence-default probe for evals/files/shared-widget-project after the shared button change. The application starts with `npm start`, and a dependency-free headless-Chrome evidence command is available through the fixture. The project supplies no rendered evidence and declares no visual-evidence form. Decide what evidence the review owes, execute that path, inspect its result, and report it briefly. Do not perform a full design checklist. Do not inspect or use BrowserSkill, bsk, or another browser-control skill.
expected_output: The review recognizes that rendered evidence is required without a project-declared form, runs the application and browser evidence path, inspects the generated artifacts, and reports their provenance without claiming unsupported formal approval.
assertions: The review recognizes that rendered evidence is required without relying on a project-declared form.
The review runs the application and browser evidence path.
The review inspects the generated artifacts and reports their source and provenance.
The review does not claim formal visual approval when the project declares no approval policy.
